cleaning_log.action: Key 'Accident_Id' (2022) renamed 'Num_Acc'; spaces stripped; values read as text, then typed.
Date built from jour/mois/an; hour from hrmn; decimal commas in GPS fixed. Points outside their territory are only left out of the point map.
Several roads listed for one accident (since 2023): main road kept, so accidents are not double-counted. Speed limits: typos fixed (500→50…), impossible values set to missing.
Age = year − birth year (impossible ages removed). People who fled (since 2021) have no injury severity: kept, but not counted as victims. 31 vehicle codes grouped into 8 modes.
